plain_language:
1. When the delivery process starts, the robot must announce the delivery via speech within 8 seconds in a quiet office environment.
2. After the robot announces the delivery, the user must acknowledge the delivery (via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds in a quiet office environment.
3. After the user acknowledges the delivery, the robot must confirm the delivery via speech within 1 second in a quiet office environment.
ig_syntax:
start → robot_announces_delivery @within(8s)
robot_announces_delivery → user_acknowledges_delivery @within(8s)
user_acknowledges_delivery → robot_confirms_delivery @within(1s)

provenance.source_text: The robot should announce the delivery via speech. → User clarified: 8 seconds
The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.
